title: 9" Large Fine Mesh Strainer with Thermo Plastic Rubber Handle - Sieve Fine Mesh Stainless Steel - Ideal Kitchen Essential to Strain Pasta, Quinoa and Rice
description:
About this item
9 inch Premium Metal strainer - Our high grade stainless steel food strainer is a must have kitchen essentials. It won`t bend or rust.
Perfect Kitchen Strainer - This fine mesh sieve will help you in handling all your straining, sieving and sifting tasks. So straining large quantity of quinoa, rice, fruits, dry baby cereals, tomato sauce, etc. is not a problem anymore with this necessary kitchen accessory!
Strainer with handle - Our fine strainer features a heat resistant thermoplastic rubber handle that allows for an improved grip even if the hands are wet and it provides protection to your hands from the heat. The wide ear hook of this sieve fine mesh comes in handy for kitchen arrangement.
Lifetime warranty - Kafoor gives lifetime warranty for this strainer. We believe in 100% customer satisfaction and quality is our priority. In case you find any issues with the product, contact us for a free replacement.
Patented Design - Our innovation team developed this useful kitchen tool specifically by understanding the consumer pain and brought a solution that suits well in your Kitchen.
